title: Estimated US bird deaths from window and building collisions per year

source.name: Bird-window collision mortality estimates (Loss et al. 2014; Kornreich et al. 2024)

notes: Loss et al. (2014, The Condor) first put US window/building-collision deaths at 365-988 million a year (median ~599 million). A 2024 PLOS ONE study (Kornreich et al.), tracking injured birds through wildlife rehabilitators, found about 60% of collision victims ultimately die -- pushing the real toll to well over 1 billion birds a year. Verified live via web search 2026-11-11.
